profiles.name: Wandering herbalist
greetings: I look for useful plants along these quiet paths.
A careful walk often reveals more than a hurried journey.
profiles.work: I study the local plants and look for patches that can be gathered without stripping the whole clearing.

profiles.name: Field cartographer
greetings: I am checking the bends and landmarks of these paths.
A good map begins with muddy boots and patient observation.
profiles.work: I compare the paths with my notes. I leave the towns and creature grounds to their own inhabitants.

profiles.name: Wilderness prospector
greetings: I am looking over the stones around this stretch of wilderness.
There is plenty to notice without venturing into a creature den.
profiles.work: I examine exposed stones and keep notes for a later expedition. Today is a scouting walk.

profiles.name: Rambling storyteller
greetings: Every traveler notices a different detail. What caught your eye?
I walk until I find something worth remembering.
profiles.work: I collect ordinary stories from travelers. Small kindnesses deserve a place beside the grand adventures.

profiles.name: Quiet wanderer
greetings: I am taking the quiet paths today.
There is no hurry. I stop when the view gives me a reason.
profiles.work: I walk the nearby trails and rest between turns. I keep away from the known hunting grounds.

profiles.name: Trail courier
greetings: I am checking the short footpaths before my next delivery.
The main road is useful, but it helps to know the nearby paths too.
profiles.work: I scout this local stretch on foot. The long-distance couriers follow the roads between towns.
